انخرمت (form VII)
# اِنْخَرَمْتُ (inḵaramtu) /in.xa.ram.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
# اِنْخَرَمْتَ (inḵaramta) /in.xa.ram.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
# اِنْخَرَمْتِ (inḵaramti) /in.xa.ram.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
# اِنْخَرَمَتْ (inḵaramat) /in.xa.ra.mat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
